violations.text: Walk in cooler two was observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Ground puree foods sausage, eggs, bread were observed held at 48DF. Establishment stated food items had been in Walk in Cooler 2 since previous morning food items were voluntarily disposed of. TCS Food items placed in Walk in 2 today were observed at 43DF and placed back in Walk in 1. Establishment placed service call for Walk in Cooler 2 New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the two door reach in. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/23/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. Establishment is to obtain thermo labels. New Violation. Correct By: 12/23/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the cooking line and hand sinks have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 11/25/2026
The tile floor in the dish pit and by the preps sins are in poor repair (loose tiles and low grout). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2027

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Establishment to send photos of cleaned and sanitized ice machine to RIDOH CFP before resuming use of ice machine. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Walk in cooler 2 was observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. TCS food items were observed at 42 DF. TCS food items were moved to walk in cooler 1. Establishment called for service to walk in cooler 2 during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026
Food items were observed stored on the floor in the walk in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The dumpster outside is located on dirt. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2026
